overall_notes: The paper focuses on resolving ambiguities in text-to-image generation through prompt disambiguation. The NLG tasks include question generation and visual setup description generation. The paper uses traditional metrics (BLEU, ROUGE) alongside VQA-based evaluation for faithfulness. While LLMs are used for generation, they are not used as judges. Human evaluation is well-documented with clear guidelines.
